parts.name: Screen
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen of the display, primarily made of glass with a thin plastic or metal frame. It is the main visual interface of the device.
parts.Functional_description: The screen displays visual output from a computer or other device, allowing users to view images, videos, and text.
parts.Movement_description: The screen itself is fixed to the stand but can tilt or swivel slightly depending on the mount design.

parts.name: Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the display, made of aluminum for stability and support. It connects to the screen via a stand.
parts.Functional_description: The base provides structural support and balance to the display, keeping it upright on a desk or surface.
parts.Movement_description: The base itself is stationary, but it may allow the screen to pivot or tilt through a hinge mechanism.
